speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: It creates good jobs for Singaporeans and raises their quality of life.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: The Ministry of Transport (MOT) will further enhance our transport network to connect Singaporeans to destinations island-wide and around the world to make Singapore our best home.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: Our aviation and maritime sectors are the lifelines of Singapore’s economy.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: They position Singapore as a global city at the heart of international business, trade and investment.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: Many in the region are working hard to replace us with shipping and flight routes bypassing Singapore.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: This will strengthen our edge to seize new opportunities and capture greater growth for Singapore.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: We are building new connections with our nearest neighbour, Malaysia.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: The Kuala Lumpur-Singapore High Speed Rail and Johor Bahru-Singapore Rapid Transit System Link will open opportunities for work and play and give both countries a greater stake in each other’s success.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: Within Singapore, we continue to enhance public transport and active mobility, so that Singaporeans can enjoy many choices for work and play.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: Construction of the Thomson-East Coast Line is underway.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: This will be followed by the Jurong Region Line and Cross Island Line.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: We are on track to bring eight in 10 households within a 10-minute walk from a train station by 2030.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: In parallel, we will develop a workforce of capable engineers and skilled technicians.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: Rail reliability is a key priority, as we make steady progress towards our Mean Kilometres Between Failure (MKBF) target of 1,000,000 train-km by 2020.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: We will continue to accelerate asset renewal and intensify maintenance of our older lines through extended engineering hours.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: To advance active mobility, all Housing and Development Board towns will have cycling networks and good bike parking facilities by 2030.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: We will introduce a licensing framework for bicycle sharing operators and registration for e-scooters by end-2018.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: This will enhance enforcement against indiscriminate parking and reckless riding and instill a more responsible user culture.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: We are reviewing the regulatory framework to license the private hire car (PHC) industry.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: We aim to keep the PHC and taxi industries open and contestable and protect the interests of commuters and drivers.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: As developments in autonomous vehicle (AV) and on-demand transport options gather pace, we will harness these technologies to provide convenient first-last mile commutes.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: To create a cleaner and greener environment, we have launched Singapore’s first large-scale electric car sharing service, which aims to deploy up to 1,000 electric cars and 2,000 charge points by 2020.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: We will also deploy for trial 50 diesel-hybrid buses by 2019 and 60 electric buses by 2020.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: As we rely less on cars, precious space will be freed up for other uses that will raise the quality of life for all Singaporeans.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: We will further digitalise services and make them more user-friendly to individuals and businesses.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: To bring greater convenience to businesses, we will put port documentation requirements onto a single portal and centralise applications for aviation safety approvals.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: We will leverage technology to enhance transport operations.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: We are using data analytics to pre-empt faults in the rail network and improve rail reliability.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: We will also use predictive analytics, machine learning and other data tools to enhance air and vessel traffic management and improve safety and efficiency.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: The Living Labs at our airport and seaport enable technology providers and industry partners to co-develop innovations in a real operating environment.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: The one-north testbed facilitates the testing and development of AVs, unmanned aircraft systems and related technologies.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: A scheme has been launched to support startups to translate new ideas into marketable solutions.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: And we will share more transport data to foster the co-creation of data-driven innovations.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: We will provide all Singaporeans good transport connectivity, regardless of their mobility needs.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: Today, all Mass Rapid Transit  stations and bus interchanges have barrier-free access.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: We will make all public buses wheelchair-accessible by 2020.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: By 2023, we will have 50 Silver Zones and triple the number of pedestrian overhead bridges with lifts.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: We are working with industry partners to develop assistive technologies for commuters with special needs, such as the Assistive Passenger Information System for the visual and hearing impaired.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: The Family-Friendly Advisory Panel is engaging diverse commuter groups to understand their mobility needs, such as families with young children.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: We will work closely with our tripartite partners and education institutions to reskill and build deep expertise within the transport workforce.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: There will be many exciting career prospects for Singaporeans and growth opportunities for Singapore companies.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: In 2019, we will mark 200 years since Sir Stamford Raffles landed on our shores.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: Our strategic geographical location on the trade route between East and West helped transform Singapore from a sleepy fishing village into a modern metropolis.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: MOT will play its part in supporting these key initiatives to build a better and brighter future for Singapore and Singaporeans.
